{"code": "import requests, datetime, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

now = datetime.datetime.now()
today = now.strftime("%Y%m%d")
beg = (now - datetime.timedelta(days=400)).strftime("%Y%m%d")

url = ("https://push2his.eastmoney.com/api/qt/stock/kline/get"
       "?secid=1.600519&fields1=f1,f2,f3,f4,f5,f6"
       "&fields2=f51,f52,f53,f54,f55,f56,f57,f58,f59,f60,f61"
       f"&klt=101&fqt=1&beg={beg}&end={today}")
headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0", "Referer": "https://quote.eastmoney.com/"}
data = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15).json()["data"]
cols = ["date","open","close","high","low","volume","amount","amplitude","pct_chg","chg","turnover"]
df = pd.DataFrame([k.split(",") for k in data["klines"]], columns=cols)
for c in cols[1:]:
    df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c])
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])

# 近一年：最近交易日往前 365 天
last_day = df["date"].iloc[-1]
start = last_day - pd.Timedelta(days=365)
dfa = df[df["date"] >= start].reset_index(drop=True)
print("分析区间:", dfa["date"].iloc[0].date(), "->", dfa["date"].iloc[-1].date(), "交易日数:", len(dfa))
print("最新收盘:", dfa["close"].iloc[-1])

# 核心统计
first_close = dfa["close"].iloc[0]
last_close = dfa["close"].iloc[-1]
hi_i = dfa["high"].idxmax(); lo_i = dfa["low"].idxmin()
year_chg = (last_close / first_close - 1) * 100
cum_max = dfa["close"].cummax()
mdd = ((dfa["close"] / cum_max - 1).min()) * 100
avg_amt = dfa["amount"].mean() / 1e8
print(f"期初收盘 {first_close:.2f}  期末收盘 {last_close:.2f}  区间涨跌幅 {year_chg:+.2f}%")
print(f"区间最高 {dfa['high'].max():.2f} @ {dfa['date'][hi_i].date()}")
print(f"区间最低 {dfa['low'].min():.2f} @ {dfa['date'][lo_i].date()}")
print(f"最大回撤(收盘) {mdd:.2f}%  日均成交额 {avg_amt:.1f} 亿")
print("上涨天数 %d / %d" % ((dfa["pct_chg"] > 0).sum(), len(dfa)))

# 均线
for w in (5, 10, 20, 60):
    dfa[f"ma{w}"] = dfa["close"].rolling(w).mean()
print("MA5/MA10/MA20/MA60 最新:", [round(dfa[f'ma{w}'].iloc[-1],2) for w in (5,10,20,60)])

# 半年分段对比
half = len(dfa) // 2
h1 = (dfa["close"].iloc[half-1] / dfa["close"].iloc[0] - 1) * 100
h2 = (dfa["close"].iloc[-1] / dfa["close"].iloc[half] - 1) * 100
print(f"前半段 {h1:+.2f}%  后半段 {h2:+.2f}%")

# 月度涨跌
dfa["ym"] = dfa["date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
m = dfa.groupby("ym").agg(open=("open","first"), close=("close","last"),
                          high=("high","max"), low=("low","min"),
                          amount=("amount","sum"))
m["pct"] = (m["close"]/m["open"]-1)*100
print(m.round(2).to_string())

dfa.to_pickle("/tmp/moutai_1y.pkl")
print("saved")

# 字体检查
from matplotlib import font_manager
cjk = [f.name for f in font_manager.fontManager.ttflist if any(k in f.name for k in ("Noto Sans CJK","WenQuanYi","SimHei","Microsoft YaHei","PingFang","Source Han","AR PL","Droid Sans Fallback"))]
print("CJK fonts:", sorted(set(cjk)))
"}
